versions.changelog: First-agent login: --start then wait, do not poll same turn; site login not a signup prerequisite; keys at /dashboard?tab=keys; homepage agentools.uno

Reposition the skill from 'broad tool gateway' to 'on-demand scoped tool client': agent searches → previews with call --dry-run (credential-free, zero-network, zero-credit preview) → shows the preview JSON to the user → only then runs the real call. Description rewritten to emphasise the narrow search-dry-run-confirm-call workflow. Requires uno-cli>=1.0.2 on PyPI which implements the --dry-run mode.

Security hardening: route all stdout through uno_cli.cli._strip_secrets so API tokens, access_tokens, refresh_tokens, and other secret-like fields are always masked (uno_abcd...wxyz) before printing. login --poll and login --key now return credential_stored_at instead of the raw token; the CLI therefore has no source-level path to leak a token to the terminal, shell history, log files, or an agent's captured stdout. Requires uno-cli>=1.0.1 on PyPI.

Rewrite SKILL.md with a 'Safety & user consent' section that makes the per-call-confirmation, user-visible, and revocation guarantees explicit. Tighten the description to describe Uno CLI as a gateway to curated third-party APIs and drop enumerated brand-name examples (the same catalogue is resolved at search time). No runtime, credential, or code changes — bin/uno.py still delegates to uno-cli>=1.0.0 on PyPI.

Refactor bin/uno.py into a thin launcher that delegates to the new uno-cli>=1.0.0 PyPI package. Future CLI bugfixes can land via 'pip install --upgrade uno-cli' without requiring a new skill release. Capability and behavior are unchanged — this skill remains a full gateway to 2000+ tools via clawdtools.uno.

Uno CLI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Command-line gateway to 2000+ real-world tools via Python 3.8+ stdlib only (no install required).
- Hybrid search (keyword/semantic) with detailed input schema feedback for tool discovery.
- Device Code OAuth with ClawdChat SSO, supporting multi-account management and API key auth.
- Tool calling with automatic authentication, pretty or compact JSON output, and rating system.
- Full support for server health checks, API key management, server browsing, and error handling best practices.
